name: Process Execution Security
purpose: Enforce strict command-line argument array invocation, environment variable sanitization, and child process sandboxing.
inputs: Approved executable allowlist and command contract
Subprocess call sites with argument and environment handling
Runtime threat model and cancellation requirements
outputs: Command-execution findings with file and line evidence
Bounded subprocess implementation and cleanup policy
Injection, timeout, output, and privilege regression evidence
stop_conditions: Unsafe shell construction is removed and every allowed process path is bounded, timed, and audited
